scripts.build:gh-pages: ng build --base-href ./ && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'), dir=fs.existsSync('dist/citrues/browser')?'dist/citrues/browser':'dist/citrues'; fs.copyFileSync(path.join(dir, 'index.html'), path.join(dir, '404.html')); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '.nojekyll'), ''); console.log('Copied index.html to 404.html and created .nojekyll for GitHub Pages');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:gh-pages && npx gh-pages -d dist/citrues/browser --dotfiles
